title: Data skill offers providers release 1 rejects
observed: The skill calls Dev, Http, InstantDB, ICloud and CloudKit "implemented provider declarations" and teaches TypeScript/Http adapters without phase marking; release 1 rejects all but Dev (Http is release 2, CloudKit release 4, InstantDB and ICloud deferred). tao-visibility repeats the list.
impact: An agent steers a release-1 user into providers the compiler refuses.
expected: Later-release and deferred providers are marked unavailable in release 1.
recheck: Compile each advertised provider under a release-1 profile.
